title: Mass Media Preference and Consumption in Rural India
description: Paper on Mass Media Preference and Consumption in Rural India published in Media Watch journal, ISSN No. 2249-8818, September 2014 issue. Co-authored with Mr. Jyoti Ranjan Sahoo.

title: Mobile Communication and Governance: the Indian Case
description: Paper co-authored with Dr. Sunetra Sen Narayan and presented at the International Conference on “Changing Landscape in Communication with New Media Technologies: Issues and Challenges,” organized by the Scripps School of Journalism, Ohio University and Sri Padmavati Mahila Visvavidyalayam Women’s University at Tirupathi, India, November 20-22, 2013. Published in IIMC journal Communicator, 2015, ISSN 0588-8093.

title: New Media and Governance: Doing it by Facebook
description: Paper presented at the National Conference on New Media and National Development organized by the Department of Communication, Bangalore University on 18-19 March, 2011.  Paper published in the annual issue of Communicator 2008, published in November 2012, ISSN: 0588-8093. Co-authored with Dr, Sunetra Sen Narayan and Ms. Shashwati Goswami.
